lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for one home wait_info test where the prediction was too low.
Evidence for most specific kinds of change remains thin because almost all categories have only a single test.
For home wait_info (2 tests), results do not yet agree: one test won (+3.6% after noise correction) while the other showed no clear effect (-0.9%).
Adoption redesign won (+5.4% after noise correction), but evidence is still thin with only one test.
Finish new_screen (-5.6%) and adoption hint (-3.3%) degraded performance, but evidence is still thin for both categories.
Layout and sign-in changes generally showed no clear effect, but evidence remains thin for each category.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Control Preview Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the final intro screen into a spotlight layout highlighting key desktop pet controls like summoning, hiding, and talking.
candidates.why: Support mails show post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or interact with pets once setup completes.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Learn how to move, summon, and interact with your new pet anytime right from your desktop menu.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro layout and copy inside onboarding is fully allowed.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step with strong support mail evidence; redesigns show promise but cost is high.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction Tutorial Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated onboarding tutorial screen demonstrating desktop pet right-click shortcuts and controls before concluding setup.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets reported confusion on how to talk to or hide the desktop pet after finishing onboarding.

new_desktop_tutorial.headline: Desktop Shortcuts & Controls
new_desktop_tutorial.body: Right-click your pet on the desktop to talk, hide, or adjust pet settings anytime.

guard.reason: Adding a new tutorial screen after the home intro inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen to the finish step previously degraded performance (-5.6%).

candidates.title: Reorder Sign-In After Friend Selection
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after choosing a pet, building engagement before requiring authentication.
candidates.why: Sign-in suffers a 27.1% drop rate when placed right at the beginning before users select a pet.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Friend
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your pet safely synced across all your desktop devices.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to take place after pet selection is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drop is large; reordering previously yielded a modest +1.6% improvement.

candidates.title: Pet Creation Safeguard Verification Flow
candidates.change: Adds a preview verification sub-screen before photo processing to confirm pet customization options.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints about custom pets failing or rendering incorrectly during the adoption stage.

new_pet_preview_check.headline: Verify Pet Appearance
new_pet_preview_check.body: Review your pet sprite preview and settings before finalizing adoption.

guard.reason: Adding a new verification sub-screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targeted at adoption drop and support complaints, but extra verification screens tend to add friction.

candidates.title: Generation Activity Progress Status
candidates.change: Displays active generation status bars and real-time progress indicators on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user drop-off without explicit progress updates.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Building your custom pet graphics and desktop animations...

guard.reason: Adding real-time progress indicators to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme wait times; wait_info has the most prior test evidence with positive net lift.

candidates.title: Companion Path Selection Tip
candidates.change: Adds an explanatory hint on the path selection screen clarifying that pet settings can be changed later.
candidates.why: The initial path selection step has a long mean time of 514s, showing hesitation among first-time users.

choose_path.hint: Select standard companion or custom creation. You can always change pets later in settings.

guard.reason: Adding an explanatory hint to the path selection screen maintains its required core job.

candidates.score_note: Cheap text addition addressing long mean duration, but hints have shown mixed results.

candidates.title: Account Safety & Cloud Pet Sync Callout
candidates.change: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to stress that signing in saves pet progress and prevents data loss.
candidates.why: Eight support emails reported missing or reset pets after re-authenticating, indicating confusion about account linking.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet Cloud Backup
sign_in.body: Sign in to ensure your pet attributes, custom memories, and settings are never lost.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy within onboarding is permitted and does not violate any rules.

candidates.score_note: Direct support ticket evidence and high drop rate; low cost copy change with expected modest lift.

candidates.title: Certificate Adoption Stage Layout
candidates.change: Changes the adoption certificate screen layout to a stage layout for a more celebratory adoption moment.
candidates.why: Adoption has a high drop rate (33.8% drop), benefit from heightened emotional reward upon completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Welcome your official desktop pet into its new home!

guard.reason: Redesigning the certificate screen layout while preserving its core function is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high drop rate (33.8%); layout/redesign changes show mild to strong positive potential.

candidates.title: Desktop Spawn Completion Notification Switch
candidates.change: Enables desktop system notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when pet loading finishes.
candidates.why: Users abandon long waiting times (mean 2336s) and write support mails when pets fail to appear on desktop.

waiting.hint: We will send a desktop popup as soon as your pet is ready to roam.

guard.reason: Adding notification prompts on the waiting screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support mails and high wait time; notification helps prevent passive abandonment.

candidates.title: Welcome Story Onboarding Introduction Copy
candidates.change: Refreshes initial story copy to set clear expectations on quick setup timing and pet interactions.
candidates.why: The first step shows a high mean duration (514s), indicating user hesitation at the very start.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Bring an interactive pet to your desktop in under two minutes.

guard.reason: Updating copy on the story onboarding screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy fix for early hesitation; low cost but expected impact is minor.
